steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A good essay has a clear structure: introduction, 3-4 developed paragraphs, and a conclusion | Key Fact: The introduction should define key terms, show understanding of the question, and indicate your line of argument | Key Fact: Use the PEEL structure for paragraphs: Point, Evidence, Explanation, Link back to the question | Key Fact: Each paragraph should focus on one main point that directly answers the question
